Mechanism (MomentumEngineConfig.exposureControl, default OFF; SimBroker.scalePosition executes the partial resizes): one sleeve-level scale λ ∈ [minScale, 1] per tick from realized BOOK vol (volCap: σ = max(σ_fast, σ_slow) of the exposure-weighted book return; λ_vol = min(1, target/σ)) and/or the RiskGuard drawdown (drawdown: linear ramp 1 → minScale between startPct and endPct of the decayed-peak dd); λ = max(minScale, min(λ_vol, λ_dd)). Each held position keeps a persisted fraction f of full size and is resized ×(λ/f) only when |λ − f| > band and the order ≥ minOrderUsd (hysteresis); reductions run even while entries are blocked, add-backs obey every entry gate and the gross cap, and never exceed full size. New entries are sized at λ. Family RW4a-c2, momentum_crypto_usdc (daily kernel d13-s5-blend-63-126-252 — the live config, artifact d0f7fd6f, data hash 55da03c9).
